Name: Horse to Pepper Rex (Horse replacer for CP and AT)
Author: TheFrenchDodo
Description:
[center][i]You want to feel the might of a monster from the past?
You really want to scare Pierre by showing into town on a dinosaur?
Then, this mod is for you!
[/i][/center]
[left]This mod replaces the horse with a Pepper Rex. That's it.

[b]Don't try giving your dinosaur a hat[/b], it will not look good.

If you feel like the galloping sound is weird for your Pepper Rex, feel free to install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5780]No Clop If It's Not a Horse it shouldn't gallop[/url]﻿.

This mod comes in two versions. The Content Patcher version will reskin the horse with a Pepper Rex and the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] version which allows you to reskin your horse in game. Please note that the AT version will not change the horse icon in your inventory.

There are 11 colour variants for your Pepper Rex:
[list]
[*]Vanilla
[*]Aqua
[*]Blue
[*]Dark
[*]Golden
[*]Iridium
[*]Mayo
[*]Orange
[*]Radioactive
[*]Red
[*]Void
[/list]
If you use the Content Patcher version, you can select which variant you want to use through the config‧json file, but I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/K8qd8Cx2/requirements.png[/img]﻿
This mod requires:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- (Optional) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/gkd9SvNf/compatibility.png[/img]﻿

Should be compatible with mostly everything, [b]except [/b]mods that alters the horse's appearance. (like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3169]Elle's New Horses[/url])

If you encounter any compatibility issue, please let me know in the Posts tab.

If you like modding your mount, I recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7911]Horse Overhaul[/url] which will give the same overhaul to your mighty Pepper Rex.
